knobs.name: pW

knobs.what: type size of a ledger value (never under 28)

knobs.what: type size of the set-type question

knobs.name: honestSize

knobs.name: tS1

knobs.what: second the spring act starts (match cut)

knobs.what: second the weather act starts (match cut)

knobs.name: tS4
knobs.what: second the chain act starts (match cut)

knobs.name: tWide
knobs.what: second the wide frame of the four sorted pictures starts

knobs.name: tQ0
knobs.what: second the question fades in

knobs.name: tHon

knobs.name: tCnt1

knobs.name: tCr1

knobs.name: tCr1e
knobs.what: act 1: the crane ends

knobs.what: act 1: the dots stand up by their error (camera still)

knobs.name: tRise1e
knobs.what: act 1: the dots have stood up

knobs.name: tHi1e

knobs.what: act 1: the keeper light ends

knobs.name: tBk1e
knobs.what: act 1: the ease-back ends

knobs.name: tRise2e

knobs.what: act 2b: the crane ends

knobs.name: tLoop
